title: Marketing Communications and Media Planning
overview: Marketing communications, including advertising, is the craft of developing and delivering messages that inform consumers about products, services, or ideas. It is a dynamic, creative, and challenging field that plays a critical role in business success. This course provides participants with both theoretical knowledge and practical insights into modern marketing communications. Participants will explore various tools, both digital and traditional, to master the advertising and communication processes needed to create impactful campaigns using diverse media techniques.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals in marketing, communications, advertising, public relations, human resources, sales, and business development who seek hands-on, contemporary knowledge of marketing strategies and communication techniques.
methodology: The course is highly interactive and includes group exercises, case studies, brief participant presentations on case findings, video analysis, and hands-on workshops.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the core principles of marketing communication and the elements of successful offline and online campaigns
Enhance brand visibility and image through well-crafted event concepts and strategies
Master the principles of Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) and apply them to ensure impactful messaging for both consumer and business audiences
Address specific marketing communication challenges and develop effective solutions
Leverage social media platforms and tactics to maximize marketing campaign returns
